intro: Service is a standing obligation of membership—measured in hours, continuity with Tampa Bay partners, and outcomes for patients and neighbors. As Chi Chapter we prioritize underserved communities across the city of Tampa, alongside MED’s national philanthropy with Gift of Life Bone Marrow Registry.

nationalPhilanthropy.name: Gift of Life Bone Marrow Registry
nationalPhilanthropy.body: In remembrance of late brother and USF chapter founder Emma Huffman, Mu Epsilon Delta named Gift of Life its national philanthropy partner. Chi Chapter hosts donor drives, educates members on the registry’s mission, and advocates for patients battling blood cancer.
goals: Learn Gift of Life’s mission and operations
Host campus donor drives for brothers and Spartans to join the registry
Coordinate with Gift of Life on local needs and follow-up
